observations.seen: Warm sunset key with a pink/orange sky gradient instead of the recipe's midday outdoor sun. The track reads as flat cream with little directional modelling, and the gates are lit almost uniformly.
The ball casts a soft blob-like shadow offset to the left. The gates and track-edge spheres show no visible contact shadows, so objects float slightly on the track.
The red ball has a single baked-looking specular highlight and rim. There is no environment reflection of the sky on the ball or the glossy gate paint.

The backdrop is rich: floating grassy islands with towers and flags, hot-air balloons, wooden pillars and a cloud sea. In the fourth frame the track is missing entirely and the ball sits on the cloud floor, which is an empty-world state.
White speed lines streak across the sky and soft clouds fill the scene. Distance haze is weak: far pillars and islands keep near-full contrast, and the speed streaks overlay the islands awkwardly.
Gates use a nice dripping-paint toon look. The track surface is a pale, low-detail texture with faint color streaks, and the dark track-edge spheres are flat purple-brown blobs.
The gates have good drip silhouettes and the islands are charming. The pillars are plain boxes with spikes, and the track is a simple ribbon lined with repeated spheres.
The ball sits low-center at roughly 10% of the frame, below the 18–25% target. Paint splatter and the lower gate cluster crowd the bottom, while the busy sky competes with the track for attention.
The camera is a behind-the-ball chase view rather than the recipe's side-on follow. Converging track lines give good depth, but the near-ground camera lets a splat decal fill the lower frame.
There is a mild outline/toon pass on objects. There is no visible bloom on the coin or sky and little color grading beyond the sunset tint; the menu frame uses a heavy desaturating dim overlay.
Paint droplets spray from gate impacts and splash decals stay on the track, which gives readable feedback. In the stills the ball shows no squash or motion blur.

Cohesive cream pill panels for score and combo, heart lives, a color meter, a power-up timer chip ('2x 5s') and a clear title card with accessibility toggles. The HUD has consistent typography and good contrast.
